name: Florida

period.description: Your share of cost is a monthly amount; you are covered from the day your bills reach it until the end of that month.

submission.description: Upload your medical bills through your MyACCESS account, fax them, mail them, or drop them off at a DCF Family Resource Center. Put your name and case number on each bill.

notes: Coverage starts on the day you meet your share of cost, not the first of the month.
A bill used to meet your share of cost in one month cannot be used again in another month.
The part of a bill paid by Medicare or other insurance does not count.
Paid bills count if paid this month or in the three months before.
